# xqmusic-player

Browser music player widget (playlist, cover, progress bar, mute toggle, scrolling LRC lyrics),
shipped as a dependency-light UMD single file for `<script>` pages plus a Vue 3 single-file component.

## Install

```sh
npm i xqmusic-player xqgjs
```

## Imports

```js
// UMD / CommonJS — the module itself is the constructor
const XqMusic = require('xqmusic-player');
// XqMusic === XqMusic.XqMusic === XqMusic.default

// DOM-free pure helpers (real ESM, no $g needed)
import { escapeHtml, pad2, formatTime, parseLyric, findLyricIndex } from 'xqmusic-player/utils';

// Vue 3 plugin (registers xq-music and xqMusic)
import xqMusic from 'xqmusic-player/vue';
// or the raw SFC
import XqMusicSfc from 'xqmusic-player/xqmusic.vue';
```

```html
<!-- classic script: global `XqMusic` + window.XqMusic -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="node_modules/xqmusic-player/lib/css/xqmusic.min.css">
<script src="node_modules/xqmusic-player/lib/js/xqmusic.min.js"></script>
```

Stylesheet path without a bundler: `xqmusic-player/lib/css/xqmusic.css` (or `.min.css`).
The Vue component imports `lib/css/xqmusic.css` itself, so a bundler needs no extra CSS import.

## Exported API

- `new XqMusic(options): XqMusicInstance`
  Injects the player markup into `options.el`. Throws `[xqmusic-player] options.el 是必填项` when
  `el` is missing, `[xqmusic-player] 找不到宿主元素: …` when the selector matches nothing, and
  `[xqmusic-player] 缺少前置依赖 $g…` when the `$g` global (xqgjs) is absent.
- `XqMusic.VERSION: string`
  Currently `'1.4.0'`.
- `XqMusic.utils: { escapeHtml, pad2, formatTime, parseLyric, findLyricIndex }`
  Same functions as the ESM `xqmusic-player/utils` entry.
- `escapeHtml(value): string`, `pad2(value): string`
- `formatTime(second): { h: 'HH:MM:SS', m: 'MM:SS' }`
- `parseLyric(text): { ti, ar, al, by, offset, ms: Array<{ t: number, c: string }> }`
  LRC parser. `ms` is sorted by `t`. Empty or non-string input returns `{ ms: [] }`, never `undefined`.
- `findLyricIndex(list, time): number`
  Binary search for the last line whose `t <= time`; `-1` when nothing matches.
- `default export of xqmusic-player/vue`: `{ version: '1.4.0', component, install(app) }`
  `install` registers the component as both `xq-music` and `xqMusic`.

### Instance methods

```js
const player = new XqMusic({ el: '#music', list, mode: 'slide' });

player.playSong();            // play / pause toggle (autoplay rejection is swallowed)
player.togglePrevSong();      // previous song, wraps to the end
player.toggleNextSong();      // next song, wraps to the start
player.toggleMusic();         // re-render current song, reset progress, pause
player.toggleListSong(event); // event-delegated playlist click handler
player.setMuted(true);        // only mute entry point; returns the new muted state
player.setLyricSource(url);   // Promise<Object|null>, pass nothing to clear the panel
player.getLyric(url);         // Promise<Object|null>, falls back to the localStorage cache
player.parseLyric(text);      // instance-level parseLyric
player.calcTimeStr(610);      // { h: '00:10:10', m: '10:10' }
player.destroy();             // idempotent teardown: unbind, pause, clear src, remove DOM
```

Deprecated, kept for compatibility and semantically inverted by name: `showMuted()` unmutes,
`showVolumn()` mutes. Prefer `setMuted(boolean)`.

Readable state: `songList`, `currentIndex`, `playStatus`, `lyricData`, `instanceId`, `version`
(`'v1.3.0'`), `pluginName` (`'XQMusicPlayer'`).

## Key Options

- `el` — **required**. CSS selector string or `Element` the player is injected into.
- `list` — `Array`, default `[]`. Song list, see schema below. With an empty list the player still
  renders the shell but binds no interaction handlers.
- `mode` — `'slide' | 'move'`, default `'slide'`. `slide` parks the player in the bottom-right corner
  and slides it out on hover; `move` makes it draggable and requires `$g.Drag` from xqgjs.

### Song schema

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "Track One",
  "author": "Artist A",
  "pic": "./cover.jpg",
  "url": "./track.mp3",
  "lyric_url": "./track.lrc"
}
```

- `id` (`number | string`, unique) — used to highlight the active row; compared as strings.
- `name`, `author` — rendered via `escapeHtml`, safe inside `innerHTML`.
- `pic` — cover URL, applied as `background-image`.
- `url` — audio URL for the `<audio>` element.
- `lyric_url` — optional. Without it the lyric panel shows `暂无歌词`.

### Vue component

`<xq-music :list="list" mode="slide" />` — props `list` (Array, default `[]`) and `mode`
(String, default `'slide'`). No events, no slots. The component fetches `lyric_url` itself with
`fetch`, needs no `$g`, and copies `list` by value, so mutating the prop array after mount is not
reactive — replace the array instead.

## Typical Use

```html
<div id="music"></div>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xqgjs/lib/xqgjs.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xqmusic-player/lib/js/xqmusic.min.js"></script>
<script>
    const player = new XqMusic({
        el: '#music',
        mode: 'slide',
        list: [
            { id: 1, name: 'Track One', author: 'Artist A', pic: './cover.jpg', url: './track.mp3', lyric_url: './track.lrc' },
        ],
    });
</script>
```

```js
// Vue 3
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import xqMusic from 'xqmusic-player/vue';
import 'xqmusic-player/lib/css/xqmusic.css';

createApp(App).use(xqMusic).mount('#app');
```

## Going Deeper

Two longer documents ship inside this same package. Read them only when this summary runs out:

- `skills/xqmusic-player/SKILL.md` — entry-selection table, load order, a symptom→cause→fix table, and
  the SPA lifecycle rules. Read it when the page already loads other scripts, when the player must
  survive route changes, or when it renders but does not behave.
- `skills/xqmusic-player/references/api.md` — full method table, DOM/CSS hooks, cache internals and
  known limits. Read it when you need a hook this file does not name, or when overriding the stylesheet.
- `skills/xqmusic-player/agents/openai.yaml` — display name and default prompt for agent hosts that
  read skill-local configuration.

## Constraints

- **`$g` global is required for the UMD constructor** (`xqgjs`, `>=1.1.0`). It is a declared optional
  peer dependency but the runtime throws without it, because `$g.dom` resolves the host element.
  The Vue component has no `$g` dependency.
- **Font Awesome 6 is expected for icons.** The markup uses `fa fa-play`, `fa fa-pause`, etc.; without
  the stylesheet the buttons render empty. Override `.fa` to supply your own glyphs.
- **Lyrics are fetched with `fetch(url, { credentials: 'same-origin' })`**, falling back to a global
  `axios` only when `fetch` is unavailable. Cross-origin lyrics need CORS enabled, otherwise the call
  fails and the cached or `暂无歌词` state is shown.
- **Vue 3 only.** The component uses `<script setup>`; Vue 2 cannot compile it.
- **Styles are scoped to `.xqmusic`** and ship separately for the UMD path — load
  `lib/css/xqmusic.css` (or `.min.css`) or the player is unstyled.
- **Lyric cache** lives in `localStorage` under a per-instance key `xqmusic:lyric:<n>`. The legacy
  shared `lyrcis` key is migrated once and then deleted. In private-mode Safari the cache silently
  degrades to memory.
- **Multiple instances per page are supported** — all lookups are scoped to the instance root and use
  class selectors. DOM `id`s (`xqmusic-audio`, …) are kept only for consumers using
  `getElementById`, so they repeat across instances.
- **Always call `destroy()`** before removing the host node in an SPA; `destroy()` is idempotent and
  also drops that instance's lyric cache.
- Theme is controlled by CSS variables/selectors in `lib/css/xqmusic.css`; no JS theming option exists.
